response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “As I was standing in line…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“He got sober and explained that he wanted to believe in God but couldn’t.”","suggested_fix":"Replace «Si fece serio» with «Si riprese» (or «Tornò in sé») to preserve the sense of becoming sober, rather than merely appearing serious.","translation_quote":"«Si fece serio e mi spiegò che avrebbe voluto credere in Dio, ma non ci riusciva.»"},{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “I’ve heard many Anabaptist people…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“I’ve heard many Anabaptist people say they can’t say that those in the worldly church are not Christians; they just don’t want to go in that direction.”","suggested_fix":"Change «È sincero?» to «È onesto?» or «È veritiero?»; the source asks whether the claim is truthful, not sincere.","translation_quote":"«È sincero?»"},{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “There was a modern church…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“They seemed to be on fire for the Lord! The pastor preached as a dying man. They were very interested in reaching the lost. But there were so many Bible teachings that they simply ignored!”","suggested_fix":"Replace «Ma ignoravano semplicemente così tanti insegnamenti biblici!» with «Ma ignoravano semplicemente moltissimi insegnamenti biblici!» to convey “so many” as a large number, not “simply so many” in the sense of merely many.","translation_quote":"«Ma ignoravano semplicemente così tanti insegnamenti biblici!»"},{"location":"source.html, paragraph beginning “It seems that most Christians in America…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Spending thousands on big hunting trips and expensive vacations is completed without a second thought.”","suggested_fix":"Replace «Si spendono migliaia di dollari in grandi battute di caccia e vacanze costose senza pensarci due volte» with «Si spendono migliaia di dollari per battute di caccia importanti e vacanze costose senza pensarci due volte»; «big» describes the trips, not the amount of money spent.","translation_quote":"«Si spendono migliaia di dollari in grandi battute di caccia e vacanze costose senza pensarci due volte.»"}],"passed":false,"score":90}
